name: 史蒂夫·乔布斯
bio_short: 美国商业大亨、设计先驱，苹果公司联合创始人。他被认为是个人计算和移动互联网时代的终极产品经理。虽然他不写代码，但他拥有敏锐的市场直觉和对完美设计的偏执追求（“现实扭曲力场”）。从Macintosh的图形界面到iPhone的多点触控，他坚持“科技与人文的十字路口”，将冷冰冰的科技产品变成了具有艺术感的生活必需品。
bio_short_en: American business magnate, design pioneer, and co-founder of Apple. Considered the ultimate product manager of the personal computing and mobile internet eras. While he didn't write code, he possessed keen market intuition and a paranoid pursuit of perfect design ('Reality Distortion Field'). From the Macintosh's GUI to the iPhone's multi-touch, he stood at the 'intersection of technology and liberal arts,' turning cold tech products into artistic necessities.
